items.source: the View instance, or null if not found (optional, to allow for ViewResolver chaining)
items.translation: View 实例，如果未找到则为 `null` （可选，以允许 ViewResolver 链式调用）

items.source: Of specific interest is the ability for some AbstractUrlBasedView implementations (for example, FreeMarker) to check if an underlying resource exists via AbstractUrlBasedView.checkResource(Locale). With this flag set to "false", an underlying resource that re-appears is noticed and used. With the flag set to "true", only one check is made.
items.translation: 特别值得注意的是，某些 AbstractUrlBasedView 实现（例如 FreeMarker）能够通过 AbstractUrlBasedView.checkResource(Locale) 检查底层资源是否存在。将此标志设置为 "false" 时，会检测到并重新使用重新出现的底层资源；而将其设置为 "true" 时，仅执行一次检查。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to loadView(String, Locale). This can be overridden to resolve certain view names in a special fashion, before delegating to the actual loadView implementation provided by the subclass.
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给loadView(String, Locale)。可以重写此方法以特殊方式解析某些视图名称，然后再委托给子类提供的实际loadView 实现。

items.source: Subclasses need to implement the loadView(String, Locale) template method, building the View object for a specific view name and locale.
items.translation: 子类需要实现loadView(String, Locale)模板方法，为特定的视图名称和区域设置构建 View 对象。

items.source: This is equivalent to setting the "cacheLimit" property to the default limit (1024) or to 0, respectively.
items.translation: 这相当于将"cacheLimit"属性设置为默认限制（1024）或 0。

items.source: Default is "true": unresolved view names are cached. Note that this flag only applies if the general "cache" flag is kept at its default of "true" as well.
items.translation: 默认值为 "true"：未解析的视图名称会被缓存。请注意，此标志仅在通用"cache"标志也保持其默认的 "true" 值时生效。

items.source: Default behaviour is to cache all views.
items.translation: 默认行为是缓存所有视图。

items.source:
Default is a String consisting of view name and locale suffix.
Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认值是一个由视图名称和区域代码后缀组成的字符串。可以在子类中覆盖此设置。

items.source:
Needs to respect the locale in general, as a different locale can
lead to a different view resource.
items.translation: 需要尊重区域设置，因为不同的区域设置可能导致不同的视图资源。

items.source:
This can be handy in case developers are able to modify views
(for example, FreeMarker templates) at runtime after which you'd need to
clear the cache for the specified view.
items.translation: 这在开发人员能够在运行时修改视图（例如 FreeMarker 模板）后需要清除指定视图的缓存时非常有用。

items.source:
Subclasses are not forced to support internationalization:
A subclass that does not may simply ignore the locale parameter.
items.translation:
子类不必强制支持国际化：
不支持国际化的子类可以简单地忽略 locale 参数。

items.source: Note: To allow for ViewResolver chaining, a ViewResolver should return null if a view with the given name is not defined in it. However, this is not required: Some ViewResolvers will always attempt to build View objects with the given name, unable to return null (rather throwing an exception when View creation failed).
items.translation: 注意：为了支持 ViewResolver 链式调用，如果未定义具有给定名称的视图，ViewResolver 应返回 `null`。然而，这并非必需：某些 ViewResolver 将始终尝试使用给定名称构建 View 对象，无法返回 `null`（而是在视图创建失败时抛出异常）。
